items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Pop Foster and Pop Foss was playing bass. [INTERVIEWEE] Well they was playing on the GS.

ctx.x: That's right, that's right. Yeah. Now you see, Charlie was playing on the same pole and Faith Marable with Lois Armstrong and Baby Dots, Johnny Sincere, Dave Jones, oh this other clarinet player, trumpet player. He was playing the first trumpet player. He was playing saxophone now, he lives in Milwaukee now. Oh, I don't remember. It would come across from the mind.
Yeah, was Pop Foster in the band then too, bass player? Yeah, Pop Foster and Pop Foss was playing bass.
Well they was playing on the GS.
